tasks.prompt: Read-only benchmark. In this repository, run `uv run kg --version` and inspect `bench/corpus/notes.md`. Do not edit files. Return exactly JSON {"pass":true,"tokens":null,"cost":null} only if version output is exactly `kg 1.0.0` and the corpus is non-empty; otherwise return the same object with pass false.

Read-only benchmark. In this repository, run `uv run kg query --help`. Do not create a vault or edit files. Return exactly JSON {"pass":true,"tokens":null,"cost":null} only if help contains --strategy, --hops, --relations, --direction, --limit, --context and --json; otherwise return the same object with pass false.
